description: Software projects Josu Aguinaga enjoyed working on, with the technologies behind each one and links to the source code.
Development of a web platform for learning programming.
The project involved implementing a modern user interface, integrating frontend and backend web technologies, and building a pedagogical feedback system based on LLM and MCP.
The end result was a functional platform that allows users to learn programming, run code effectively, and receive personalized feedback.
programming-learning-platform.title: Web platform for learning programming: pedagogical feedback through LLM and MCP

description: Development of a convolutional neural network model for galaxy image analysis.
The project involved implementing deep learning algorithms based on ResNet and residual blocks, training and evaluating the model, and visualizing the results.
The end result was an efficient and accurate model that can classify galaxy images with high precision.
galaxycnn.title: GalaxyCNN

description: Creation of a version of the Snake game for the Nintendo DS, using C and the libnds library for homebrew development.
The project involved implementing game mechanics, handling graphics, optimizing performance on the console, and researching the hardware's capabilities.
The end result was a functional and entertaining game that demonstrates skills in low-level programming and software development for specific platforms.
nintendo-ds-snake.title: Nintendo DS Snake

description: Development of a media streaming service offering both pre-recorded videos and live broadcasts.

The project involved splitting the system into several Docker containers: nginx as a reverse proxy that receives the live stream over RTMP and repackages it as MPEG-DASH, an Express and Pug web server, and an FFmpeg pipeline that converts videos into multiple qualities for adaptive streaming.
The end result was a website with three players, built with dash.js and Video.js, where viewers can watch adaptive-quality videos, switch quality manually and tune into a live broadcast.
multimedia-streaming.title: Multimedia streaming service

voip.title: VoIP telephone exchange with Asterisk
description: Setup of a Voice over IP telephone exchange with Asterisk, compiled from source inside a Docker container, using Zoiper softphones as the phones.

The project involved configuring SIP over UDP with PJSIP templates for four extensions, writing the dialplan that routes calls between them, giving each extension its own voicemail box, and adding call forwarding from one extension to another with a spoken notice for the caller.

The end result was a working phone system where extensions can call each other, leave voicemail when nobody answers, and listen to their own messages from a single number that identifies them by caller ID.

haskell-calendar.title: Calendar in Haskell
description: Development of a command-line program in Haskell that prints the calendar of any year.

The project involved building a small library of text drawings that are stacked and placed side by side with higher-order functions, calculating the weekday each month starts on and handling leap years, and validating the user's input interactively.
The end result was a compact program that lays out all twelve months of the chosen year as a custom grid in the terminal.
